QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` is defined only when `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` is set and `__GNUC__` is present (armcc5 is excluded).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is defined from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus compiler predefined macros, with selection "purely preprocessor-driven". That states it is derived rather than set in the config file.
